label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: It is impossible that there be no first efficient…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: Ergo est necesse ponere aliquam causam efficientem primam
interpretation: The conclusion, read as the impossibility of there being no first efficient cause (double negation, as for the prima via). 'Prima' is read as efficiently caused by nothing; nothing further (uniqueness, being, God) is read into it.
